errors.error_description: Assigned a continuous driver to an input port declared as a variable (logic), driving the input from within the module.
Used always_comb with an incomplete assignment to temp_accum, inferring a latch due to missing else/default assignment.
Assigned a 16-bit vector (wide_status) to an 8-bit vector (narrow_status) without explicit truncation, causing width mismatch.
Created an unconnected internal net by driving spare_bus with no consumers, representing an internal wiring/connectivity defect.
